reviews.text: This bar is a hidden gem of Seoul nightlife! The prices are unbelievably cheap, so you can get high or downright drunk for very little money. It's the best value for money. The atmosphere is fantastic, so it's great to mingle with locals, and since everyone is there to have fun, there's no sense of distance at all. The food is surprisingly delicious, unlike what you'd normally find at a typical bar, and the staff is friendly and attentive, recommending signature cocktails. ​​The interior is not luxurious, but this simplicity creates a comfortable atmosphere. The only downside is that the music is sometimes too loud and you have to raise your voice to have a conversation. However, if you want to experience the true drinking culture of Seoul and make good use of your budget, I recommend this place! I will definitely visit again next time I go to Seoul.

reviews.text: I had dinner at this restaurant with my family over the weekend and was overall satisfied. The signature dish, braised pork belly, had a great flavor and had a perfect balance between lean meat and fat, giving it a texture that melted in your mouth. It was really great when eaten with rice! The steamed sea bass was also very fresh, perfectly cooked, tender and moist. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the food came out at a reasonable speed so we didn't have to wait long. The atmosphere was simple yet elegant, and the space between seats was wide so you could enjoy a comfortable meal. The downside is that the price is a bit high and the quantity is small, so the cost-effectiveness is average. Additionally, we recommend making a reservation as waiting times may be long during peak hours. Overall, it is recommended for those who value the quality of ingredients, and is also suitable for business dinners or family gatherings. I think it would be a better restaurant if the portions and prices were adjusted.

Prices are a bit high, starting at 45,000 won per bottle, but still reasonable. Overall, it's good for a quick drink with friends, but it may be a bit disappointing to visit alone. reviews.author: MetalerMetaller
reviews.text:
*Franchise wine bar with great atmosphere

I was satisfied with a glass of wine in Bangi-dong, so I stopped by Wangsimni Branch.
Although there is an image that franchises destroy local businesses, it is beneficial to consumers in that they can enjoy franchised businesses at a similar level in any region by providing decent service. Wangsimni branch and Bangi branch felt to be of almost similar quality.
It's great to have a glass of wine as you can enjoy a variety of wines at a low price while enjoying the pretty interior and colorful lighting.

If you come as a group, it is cheaper to order by bottle. If you come in a small group, it is better to enjoy several types of drinks at a low price.
As for the snacks, I am satisfied as the quality matches the atmosphere.

reviews.text:
This movie theater is located on the 5th floor of Bitplex Mall, connected to the private station at Wangsimni Station, where four subway lines, including Line 2, pass. (Go out of the ticket gate and enter the connected building where the mart is located)

I watched the movie "Avatar" at a 4DX theater. If you tilt your head slightly back in row C, the viewing angle was clear without much discomfort, but I suspect it might be somewhat uncomfortable in rows A and B. (4DX, 3D + seat, wind, water effects + left and right screen expansion)

If you come down to the 4th floor after watching a movie, there are many restaurants, so you can grab a meal without having to go outside. Parking is 2,000 won for 3 hours when watching a movie.

reviews.author: Choi Pan-dong
reviews.text: CGV inside Wangsimni Station. It's quite spacious and comfortable. I especially liked the screen and sound of the IMAX theater. However, it can be a little confusing the first time you go.

reviews.author: Kisu Kwon
reviews.text:
After the COVID-19 outbreak, the number of people in theaters decreased significantly due to the performance of OTT, and in addition, large multiplex theaters, including CGV, continued to raise movie ticket prices, making theaters even more deserted. Marvel, which was good at making blockbusters, is fading, and theaters are fading along with it. Unintentionally, this turned the theater into a very pleasant environment.

Nevertheless, since there are many people who have completely stopped going to theaters, it is likely that theaters will continue to be idle unless ticket prices are lowered or an extremely great blockbuster movie is released.
